raw_text: BREAKING: Explosions reported at two Oil India Limited valve stations along Duliajan-Numaligarh crude oil pipeline in Tinsukia district, Assam. Major oil spill underway affecting wetland areas. Security forces rushing to the area. ULFA-I has claimed responsibility through their Telegram channel. IEDs used in the attack.
clean_text: Explosions at two OIL valve stations in Tinsukia causing major oil spill in wetlands. ULFA-I claims responsibility. IEDs used in attack on Duliajan-Numaligarh pipeline.
